name: Ring-2.6-1T
short: InclusionAI's Ring-2.6-1T open-weights reasoning MoE (1T total/63B active, 128K native) for thinking tasks; adjustable Reasoning Effort high/xhigh.
pricingNote: AA ~$0.30/$2.50 per 1M; MIT open weights, but self-hosting needs ~32 GPUs (vendor SGLang example: 4 nodes x 8)
freeTierNote: Free OpenRouter endpoint at $0.00/1M. Hugging Face reports no Inference Provider deploys the weights directly.
